correctness.rationale: For all q_i in (0,1) with pairwise q_i+q_j>=1, the Euclidean distance minimization proves the ball-hull cap-body premise. If some pair is strict, c_i^2+c_j^2<1 yields an open unit-circle arc, and nearby nonparallel u,u′ give four exact unit directions covering all six spikes by strict tests. The zero-sum identity with linearly independent first three directions proves full positive spanning. The primary cap-body criterion then illuminates the entire K; any 3D convex body requires at least four. All-equality forces q_i=1/2 and six individual vertex obstacles. No numerical experiment substitutes for these quantified steps. The recorded checker from its actual package path passed structured and randomized finite consistency checks.
